description: Compute the real WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio and APCA lightness contrast for a foreground/background pair, and return the nearest passing colour in the same hue. Use whenever a skill needs a contrast number — accessibility-audit, design-system-audit, design-handoff-brief, brand-guidelines, any Figma review. A ratio cannot be judged by eye: #777777 on white is 4.478 (fails AA) and #767676 is 4.542 (passes), and no amount of looking separates those. Deterministic arithmetic — no model call, no network.

background.description: The colour it sits on, as a six-digit hex, e.g. "#ffffff".

foreground.description: The text colour, as a six-digit hex, e.g. "#8ab4f8".

level.description: The bar to clear. Defaults to AA (4.5:1), the legal standard in most jurisdictions.

name: check_contrast

apca.description: APCA Lc, signed. Positive is dark text on light.

apcaUse.description: What APCA says this contrast is good enough for.

nearestPassing.description: A close colour to the foreground that clears the level, holding the hue roughly steady. Null if it already passes. For an exact perceptual answer on saturated colours, run `npx notugly fix <fg> <bg>`, which walks OKLCh lightness instead of RGB.

passes.description: Whether it clears the requested level.

says.description: A one-line summary suitable for pasting into an audit table.

title: Check colour contrast
